legend: After participating in the MFP (Matchup of Finalists in Ping-pong) in Campinas, Giovana and Julia are tired of playing ping-pong and decide they need to devise a new sport. They want a sport that, besides physical performance, requires mathematical reasoning and strategy. As both are very fond of binary numbers, they thought of the following game, which they named "Bit Tennis", to play against each other:
The game starts with a string $$$S$$$, of size $$$N$$$, that represents a number in binary;
Giovana begins the game and thereafter they alternate turns between Julia and her;

In each round, the current player can add one more digit ("0" or "1") to the end or the beginning of the string: for example, if the string is "110", the player can turn it into "1100", "1101", "0110" or "1110".
If, after $$$K$$$ turns from each player, the number is a multiple of 3, Julia wins. Otherwise, Giovana wins.

Both quickly learned to play optimally and, after playing a few times, they noticed that the game's outcome is always determined before the first move is even made. Curious about this fact, they asked for your help to, given the initial string and number of turns, find out which one of them will win.
input: The first line of the input consists of the integer $$$N$$$ $$$(1 \leq N \leq 10^5)$$$, the size of the string $$$S$$$, and the integer $$$K$$$ $$$(1 \leq K \leq 10^5)$$$, the number of moves each one will make.
The second line contains the string $$$S$$$, which represents the binary number the game starts with, from the most significant bit to the least significant.
output: Print "GIOVANA" or "JULIA", the name of the winner of the game if both play optimally.

legend: 在坎皮纳斯参加了乒乓球决赛选手对抗赛（MFP）之后，乔瓦娜和朱莉娅厌倦了打乒乓球，决定要设计一项新的运动。她们希望这项运动除了需要身体素质外，还需要数学推理和策略。由于两人都非常喜欢二进制数，她们想到了下面这个游戏，并将其命名为 "比特网球"，用来互相对抗：
游戏以大小为$$$N$$$的字符串$$$S$$$开始，该字符串表示二进制数字
乔瓦娜开始游戏，之后朱莉娅和她轮流上场；
在每轮中，当前玩家可以在字符串的末尾或开头添加一个额外的数字 (“0” 或 “1”)。例如，如果字符串是 “110”，玩家可以将其转换为 “1100”、“1101”、“0110” 或 “1110”。
如果 $$$K$$$ 从每个玩家手中转出后，数字是 3 的倍数，茱莉亚获胜。否则，乔瓦娜获胜。
他们都很快学会了最优化的玩法，在玩了几次之后，他们注意到游戏的结果总是在第一步行动之前就已经确定了。出于对这个事实的好奇，他们请求你的帮助，在给定初始字符串和回合数的情况下，找出他们中哪一个会赢。
input: 输入的第一行包括整数 $$$N$$$ $$$(1 \leq N \leq 10^5)$$$、字符串的大小 $$$S$$$，以及整数 $$$K$$$ $$$(1 \leq K \leq 10^5)$$$，即每次移动的次数。
第二行包含字符串 $$$S$$$，它代表游戏开始时的二进制数，从最有效位到最小有效位。
output: 打印“GIOVANA”或“JULIA”，如果两者都发挥最佳，则游戏获胜者的名字。
